name: Tatakai
subtitle: Extension-based anime & manga app for iOS
description: Official Tatakai source for AltStore, SideStore and StikStore. Tatakai is an extension-based otaku community for tracking anime & manga — install the iOS build with your own Apple ID. Free accounts must refresh every 7 days.

apps.name: Tatakai
apps.subtitle: Discover, watch, and read — your way
apps.localizedDescription:
Tatakai brings anime discovery, streaming, manga reading, and community features together in one customizable app. Its extension-first design lets you choose your sources.

THIS IS AN UNSIGNED BUILD for sideloading only: it cannot be installed directly. Add this source in AltStore / SideStore (or open the IPA in TrollStore) to sign it with your own Apple ID. Tatakai does not host media files; users access media through third-party extensions and are responsible for complying with applicable laws.
apps.versionDescription: Tatakai 6.1.0 for iPhone & iPad. Unsigned build: sideload with AltStore, SideStore or TrollStore using your own Apple ID, then refresh before the 7-day free-account expiry. See the GitHub release notes for the full changelog.
